scientific_integrity: The proof establishes the stated expectations using exact tree messages and a factorial influence tail. Finite first-arrival recursion is a supplementary check. A bibliographic exclusion is not claimed for inaccessible prior material. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One isolated chord, fixed positive chord rate, cyclic separation in both directions; expectation limit only. Uniform-in-rate bounds, fluctuation laws, and finite-order threshold claims are not established. Some older source full texts are inaccessible.
title: A rate-driven Braess reversal for one long chord in random dimer adsorption
